comment: EMC per 1000 mB of each fluid, for the prestige mod (ProjectE cannot hold fluid values at runtime). Unlisted fluids are worth 0. A filled bucket's EMC must equal the empty bucket plus this value: vanilla buckets use ProjectE's defaults (lava = default lava bucket 832 - empty bucket 768), GT buckets are set in config/ProjectE/custom_emc.json.
